answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a defined half-life, so sustained honest service is required to retain EigenTrust matrix-factorization score and eigenvector centrality. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted history; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap collusion. It therefore cannot pass consensus, whether aliases are violet, ivory, or clustered at a knoll.
